info.title: Biho Live Step 8 Identity
info.description: Google nonce-bound mobile flow and PostgreSQL-authoritative opaque sessions. See docs/architecture/IDENTITY_AUTH.md for security policy.

identifier.description: ASCII username normalized by trimming surrounding ASCII whitespace and lowercasing, or exact E.164 phone. Email is forbidden.

password.description: Length is 1–128 UTF-8 bytes, not Unicode code points. No trimming or ASCII-only restriction. Enforce x-utf8-byte-length; generic JSON Schema minLength/maxLength cannot express this byte policy.
Length is 12–128 UTF-8 bytes, not Unicode code points. No trimming or ASCII-only restriction. Enforce x-utf8-byte-length; generic JSON Schema minLength/maxLength cannot express this byte policy.

current_password.description: Length is 0–128 UTF-8 bytes, not Unicode code points. No trimming or ASCII-only restriction. Enforce x-utf8-byte-length; generic JSON Schema minLength/maxLength cannot express this byte policy.
Length is 1–128 UTF-8 bytes, not Unicode code points. No trimming or ASCII-only restriction. Enforce x-utf8-byte-length; generic JSON Schema minLength/maxLength cannot express this byte policy.
